summary: Batch 1 (系統配置) end-to-end backend + frontend testing. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass covering /admin/me, roles CRUD, admins list/promote/revoke, integration-settings get/put with masking, test-send, operation-logs + CSV export, and 401/403 authZ. Frontend: full flow via Clerk sign-in → /admin/login TOTP → admin console. Verified sidebar role label (超級管理員), 系統配置 group expands and all 6 leaves (admins/roles/operation-logs/sms-config/email-config/oauth-config) render. Roles page create/edit/delete working. SMS integration fields: secret fields (DAGOU_KEY, SUBMAIL_APPKEY) are type=password with masked placeholder like '••••••85fa'; non-secrets show real values. Email + OAuth fields render; OAuth has NO test button (correct). Admins table shows self with crown + 2FA 已啟用 + '我', no self-revoke button, bad-email promote shows '找不到該用戶' toast. Operation logs populated with POST/PUT/DELETE entries from our role writes; search by 'roles' filters correctly; CSV export returns 200 text/csv.
critical_code_review_comments: admin_api.py is now 1780 lines — approaching maintainability threshold; consider splitting the newly appended 系統配置 section into a submodule (e.g., admin_sysconfig.py) before the next batch grows it further.
Audit middleware in server.py excludes '/operation-logs' from logging but will still log successful GETs would be noisy — current implementation correctly limits to POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH, good.

Integration PUT (admin_integration_put) correctly skips masked placeholders (val.startswith(MASK)) and empty strings — verified via backend test test_put_masked_secret_does_not_overwrite; secret preservation works.

Backend GET /integration-settings only accepts a 'super' admin — intentional per spec. Non-super admins with the 'sms-config' permission currently cannot view/edit integration settings; if that's the desired model (super-only system-config) it's fine, otherwise consider gating by permission later.
RolesAdmin modal 'Escape' key does not close the dialog; it has to be closed via the 取消/X button. Not a blocker but may be UX improvement (add Escape listener).
